text: About Qingdao University As one of the 50 Universities approved the qualification of enrolling international students by Ministry of Education, Qingdao University started enrollment of international students from 1987. Qingdao University was approved as HSK test center by Confucius Institute Headquarters (Hanban) in 1997. In 2016, over 1600 international students from 61 countries come to study at Qingdao University. Institute Introduction The School of Economics, Qingdao University was established in 2000. Its predecessor was the Department of Finance and Monetary Economics, established in 1992. The School of Economics consists of six academic departments at present.Among the Master and Doctoral Programs, the finance discipline was “the 9th. Five-Year” key disciplines of Shandong Province, “the 11th. Five-Year” strengthening construction of key disciplines and “the 12th. Five-Year” key disciplines.The Finance major is Shandong provincial Brand and Featured major.The School of Economics has two research bases in humanities and social sciences sponsored by Shandong Province. The School of Economics owns a national experimental teaching demonstration center (the Liberal Arts Experimental Teaching Center of Qingdao University) and several high-level professional laboratories. The faculty of the School of Economics counts around 100 persons, among whom, more than 90 are full-time teachers, and 80 percent with Ph.D. There are 18 professors, 31 associate professors, 14 doctoral tutors, and 36 Master Instructors in the School of Economics. CoursesOffered Foundations of Economic Analysis Monetary Theory and Policy Financial markets and financial institutions Investment Analysis Financial Statement Analysis Econometric analysis Corporate Finance Financial derivatives tools and risk management International Finance and Foreign Exchange Investment Practice Fund operation and management Personal finance and case analysis Analysis on Fixed Income Securities Theory and Practice of Investment Banks Chinese Integrated Chinese Culture Living Environment Students are expected to live in the International Students Dormitory, where single and double rooms are available. Every room is equipped with central heating facilities. Rooms have private shower baths and toilets; all rooms are installed with air-conditioners. Shared kitchens and washing machines are also accessible to students in the dormitory. The University campuses enjoy tranquil and convenient surroundings. All kinds of daily necessities are available in off-campus supermarkets at low prices. Post offices and banks are near the main gate of each campus. City bus routes connect all campuses with the downtown area, scenic spots, and the train station. Study Duration 2 Years Fee Structure Tuition Fee RMB 20,500/year Accommodation Fee RMB 11,000–13,000/year (Double room) Accommodation Deposit RMB 800/year Insurance Fee RMB 800/year Note: 1. This fee structure will be used from the beginning of study until graduation. 2. All the fees should be paid in Chinese currency (RMB) 3. The tuition fee can be paid either in cash or by draft, and all other fees must be paid in cash. The cost for receiving a draft must be paid by the students. 4. There can be no refunds available (for fees of any kind) if requested for personal reasons during the period of study at our university.
